answer: According to the EDPB Statement 3/2024, data protection authorities (DPAs) must supervise high-risk AI systems listed in point 1 of Annex III of the AI Act, particularly those used for law enforcement purposes, border management, and justice and democracy. Additionally, DPAs should be designated as market surveillance authorities (MSAs) for high-risk AI systems listed in points 6, 7, and 8 of Annex III, which are key elements of the democratic order. The EDPB recommends that DPAs act as the single points of contact for the public and counterparts at Member State and Union levels.
